reasoning_traces.think:
The core duality lies between data availability and data trust. The system operates under a Bayesian lens where trust is a conditional probability over legal and source credibility. The coverage gap ratio acts as a proxy for data sufficiency, which directly impacts model confidence. The licensed data dependency introduces a constraint that forces the system to prioritize contractual data acquisition. Failure modes include overconfidence in sparse data, misalignment between UX and data reality, and underestimation of licensing costs. These primitives form a triadic structure: trust (T_d), coverage (R_c), and dependency (D_l) interact through a kernel-based inference engine to produce actionable intelligence.
